chunks: And by this chain, from Muhammad ibn Sadaqah, from Malik ibn 'Atiyyah, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever visits the grave of Abu 'Abdillah, Allah writes for him eighty accepted Hajj pilgrimages.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* emphasizes the spiritual merit of visiting the shrine of Imam Ja'far al-Sayyara of Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), equating a single visitation to eighty accepted Hajj pilgrimages. In Shia tradition, this immense reward underscores the Imam’s role as a spiritual guide whose presence facilitates divine forgiveness and merit, linking the physical act of Ziyarat to the spiritual journey of the soul.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 39. And from the previous chain from Muhammad b. Sadaqah from Malik b. ’Atiyyah from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) says that if a person does the Ziyarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) once knowing his right the Almighty Allah would note down a reward of an accepted Hajj.
